notes.title: My Bones Trading Cards Released!
notes.content:
We recently created Trading Cards for the game. 
7 Trading cards, 3 Profile Backgrounds and 5 Emoticons are available. Cards drop every 10 minutes playing time. 

[list]
[*]- Trading cards.
[*]- Profile backgrounds.
[*]- Emoticons.
[*]- Badges.
[/list]

notes.title: Small update...
notes.content:
Most of the bugs in the game was fixed!

The list of bugs fixed:
-Removed doors preventing to pass.
-Reduced number of keys on all levels.
-Changed some textures.
-Fixed dock floor in the dungeon.
-Fixed monster that appeared and didn't move.
-Added secret tips and tricks.
-Fixed the grass in the woods,now its mush.
-Changed the location of the key in the woods,now its easy to find.
-Added some items to the level-2,such as chains,straw,and so on..
-Added stalker at level-1.

Most of the errors fixed,thanks for understanding)
